components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 主操作按钮，用于添加账号与保存配置。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #237c61; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #237c61; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 650 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #1d6852; outline: 2px solid #237c61; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: 面板、表格和指标摘要的通用容器。
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; color: #203c32; border: 1px solid #dce5dd; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(29,65,44,.035); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 650 15px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: 白色工作区配合浅灰页面底色和鼠尾草绿行动色；数据紧凑，控件和分区保持呼吸感。
donts: 不用高饱和色大面积铺底
